name: Slammin' Saturday Night

matches.note: Hardcore Title Tournament, round one. Lucy Law defeated Rich Jericho with a full-nelson slam ("the Miranda") after he struck her twice.

Hardcore Title Tournament, round one. GODSEND substituted for a suspended Road House and had the match won until President Kozak ran in and struck him from behind with a baseball bat, letting Eric Fox pin him.
Hardcore Title Tournament, round one. Jimmy "Me Smash" outlasted Ian Duncan after both men kicked out of early pin attempts.
Mixed tag exhibition, non-title. BFF's debut; Carissa Marsh pinned Eric Fox with a top-rope powerbomb.
Hardcore Title Tournament, round one. Ragnarok pinned Assault of the stable Death Row after a DDT.

notes: The fed's own weekly broadcast, opening the Hardcore Title Tournament's first round. President Kozak's own interference in match two cost GODSEND the match; the tournament's later rounds (a quarterfinal pairing Joe Cageneli against GODSEND, and Battery against Mr. Macphisto) were announced in a later Trash Talk segment but no further round's results survive in the held record.
